verdict.rationale: The Snowflake CLI runs headlessly (verified via runtime probe with snow sql supporting inline queries, file/stdin piping, and variable substitution) and the SQL API/REST API let an agent authenticate, submit SQL, and retrieve results entirely without Snowsight; RBAC governs access and Access History/Query History provide governance visibility over that programmatic activity. Combined with the documented Cortex MCP server for agent-native access, this covers authenticate to query to read-results end-to-end via CLI/API. missing for 10: explicit first-party example of schema discovery (e.g., SHOW/DESCRIBE) via CLI/API in an agent workflow, and independent non-Snowflake confirmation of full headless governed round-trips
